svg.aria-label: DeliveryOps: Multi-agent platform for application-maintenance teams. Agents read the project's real data (Jira exports, the contract, timesheets, meeting transcripts) and prepare the pre-invoice, the steering committee deck and the capacity plan. Nothing is applied until a person approves it.
